caption: The drawing depicts a doll viewed from the back, seated with its legs slightly apart. The doll has a plain, wooden head and hair painted or drawn in brown, with a braid wrapping around the head. It is dressed in a blue dress decorated with evenly spaced white polka dots. The sleeves of the dress are elbow length and the skirt is voluminous. Beneath the dress, a white petticoat with fine vertical stripes is visible, as well as a yellow underskirt patterned with white dots. The doll also wears brown shoes. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or details. At the bottom of the drawing, the name "Jacob Gilens" is written in small, neat letters.
title: Corn Husk Doll
